title: Remove the 1 GiB disk requirement from the oversized project marker test
outcome: Remove the 1 GiB disk requirement from the oversized project marker test
acceptance: The pre-open oversized marker regression uses a small length above MAX_PROJECT_FILE_BYTES and still proves refusal before opening, without requiring roughly 1 GiB of free disk.

completion.summary: Reduced the oversized marker fixture to 4097 bytes while preserving exact-boundary coverage and the callback proof of refusal before opening.
